content:
**Dark Hollow Manor** or **Stolz Manor** [1] is a location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Skyline Valley* update.

The manor forms the center of a greater area. Surrounding the manor are chasms, some of which contain health hazards in the form of violet-colored pools on the ground. Some of the chasms may be traversed by makeshift bridges, or deformed trees that allow jumping across them. The property's boundary is marked by a derelict stone wall, often found with with gaps in between, allowing to enter the property at will.

The main gate (and also the fast travel point) lies north of the manor. Due east of the manor are a number of small walkways, as well as a gazebo, a fountain, and a lion statue. Southeast of the manor is an ambush point in form of a tree, from which a hostile Hulking Mega Sloth may drop down. West of the manor are a destroyed gardening shack, and an initially inaccessible stone building that requires the Dark Hollow Security Key. To the northwest are a parking lot, with a guard post connecting to the road leading away from the property in an eastern direction.

The manor itself has little of interest, and is only accessible by a door on the building's northern side.

The Interior consists of great hall with two levels, the upper level being accessible by stairs, and many inaccessible doors. On the western wall is a door, which leads to a set of stairs and down into the basement's wine cellar and bar. An intercom and a hand scanner are located on the southern wall. Behind the southern wall, an elevator leads down to Vault 63.

Dark Hollow Manor appears in *Fallout 76*.
